min_standing_note.value: Graduate (Master-level) exchange for nominated partner students; Spring semester exchange spots are very limited.
min_standing_note.notes: Confirmed in Hertie School Exchange Fact Sheet 2024 page 1.

agreement_scope_raw.value: GAPP only/ Incoming students are not restricted only ours !

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Excel row 40 specifies 'GAPP only/ Incoming students are not restricted only ours !' (GR, Fall/Spring).

eligible_majors.notes: Open to graduate programs within AUC's School of Global Affairs and Public Policy (GAPP) per row 40.

english_course_availability.notes: Instruction language at Hertie School is English.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: TOEFL iBT 100, IELTS 7.0 (minimum 7.0 Writing), Cambridge CAE Grade B, or CPE Grade C (waived for native speakers or if previous undergraduate degree was completed entirely in English).
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Hertie School of Governance/2024/Hertie School Exchange Fact Sheet 2024.pdf#page=1

host_language_requirement.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Hertie School of Governance/2024/Hertie School Exchange Fact Sheet 2024.pdf#page=1

fall_term_dates.value: Fall Semester: Aug 1 – Jan 31 (required physical attendance late August – mid-December).
fall_term_dates.notes: Also stated in Hertie School Exchange Fact Sheet 2024 page 1.

spring_term_dates.value: Spring Semester: Feb 1 – Jul 31 (very few Spring exchange spots available).
spring_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Hertie School of Governance/2021-2022/Hertie Study abroad Flyer 2021.pdf#page=1
spring_term_dates.notes: Feb 1 – Jul 31 term dates from 2021 flyer page 1; limited Spring availability confirmed on 2024 fact sheet page 1 and academic-exchanges-inbound.

tuition_model.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Hertie School of Governance/2024/Hertie School Exchange Fact Sheet 2024.pdf#page=2
tuition_model.notes: Exchange students pay tuition only to their home institution and are waived from Hertie tuition.

est_monthly_living_local.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Hertie School of Governance/2024/Hertie School Exchange Fact Sheet 2024.pdf#page=2
est_monthly_living_local.notes: 2024 Exchange Fact Sheet page 2 budgets 650 EUR housing + 120 EUR health insurance + 400 EUR other expenses = 1,170 EUR/month.

living_cost_usd_est.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Hertie School of Governance/2024/Hertie School Exchange Fact Sheet 2024.pdf#page=2
living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month exchange semester estimate: 1170 EUR/month * 5 months * 1.1052 = 6465.42 USD using ECB 2026-11-13 rate (1 EUR = 1.1052 USD, https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html, collected 2026-11-15).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Campus/semester fee approx. 300 EUR/semester (Studentenwerk + BVG semester ticket, 289.40 EUR itemized on tuition-and-fees page) plus compulsory health insurance.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Hertie School of Governance/2024/Hertie School Exchange Fact Sheet 2024.pdf#page=2

housing_availability.notes: Hertie does not operate its own dorms; Student Affairs & Study Abroad provides guidance on student dorms, shared flats (WGs), Neon Wood, and the Hertie Homes initiative (2024 fact sheet page 2).

housing_notes.value: Students secure Berlin housing independently with guidance from Hertie Student Affairs (dorms, WGs, private residences, and Hertie Homes).
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Hertie School of Governance/2024/Hertie School Exchange Fact Sheet 2024.pdf#page=2

host_grants_or_stipends.value: Small living grants may occasionally be available and advertised at the start of semester (per 2021-2022 flyer; availability not guaranteed).
host_grants_or_stipends.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Hertie School of Governance/2021-2022/Hertie Study abroad Flyer 2021.pdf#page=2

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU citizens requiring a German student visa should apply at least 3 months in advance.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Hertie School of Governance/2024/Hertie School Exchange Fact Sheet 2024.pdf#page=2
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Exact German blocked-account EUR threshold not listed in Hertie fact sheet.

course_catalog_url.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Hertie School of Governance/2024/Hertie School Exchange Fact Sheet 2024.pdf#page=1
course_catalog_url.notes: Course catalogue URL printed on 2024 Exchange Fact Sheet page 1.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS system; workload ranges from 6 to 30 ECTS per semester depending on home university requirements.
credit_system_and_load.notes: Also stated on 2024 Exchange Fact Sheet page 1.

course_restrictions_note.value: MPP and MIA courses are open to exchange students; Master of Data Science (MDS) courses require satisfying prerequisites (2024 fact sheet page 1).
course_restrictions_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Hertie School of Governance/2024/Hertie School Exchange Fact Sheet 2024.pdf#page=1

academic_style.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Hertie School of Governance/2024/Hertie School Exchange Fact Sheet 2024.pdf#page=1

international_support_services.value: Orientation program, visa support, Hertie Homes housing guidance, and Student Affairs & Study Abroad advising.
international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Hertie School of Governance/2024/Hertie School Exchange Fact Sheet 2024.pdf#page=2

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall: Nomination April 15 (academic-exchanges-inbound & 2024 fact sheet page 1); Spring: Nomination November 15 per 2021 flyer page 1 (very limited Spring places).
